summary_1line: Night battles rage: Aswatthaman wounds Ghatotkacha, Bhima and Duryodhana duel fiercely, and Karna humiliates and disarms Sahadeva.

image_candidates.scene_text: Aswatthaman fires a golden-winged shaft that pierces Ghatotkacha’s chest and drives into the earth as the Rakshasa collapses on his chariot.
Bhima hurls a blazing iron mace that smashes Duryodhana’s chariot, killing the horses and driver in the darkness of the battlefield.
Weaponless Sahadeva leaps down and hurls a chariot wheel at Karna, who shreds it midair with a storm of arrows.
